title: Bohr's Atomic Model & Planck's Quantum Theory
notes:
Bohr's Atomic Model & Planck's Equation

Electrons orbit in stationary non-radiating energy shells (K, L, M, N... / n = 1, 2, 3...).
Energy changes occur during quantum jumps between ground and excited states.
Planck's Equation: E = h·ν = hc/λ (h = 6.626×10⁻³⁴ J·s, c = 3×10⁸ m/s).
summary: Bohr's stationary orbits, quantum jumps, and photon energy.
